summary: Tested has_video filter + 'Con video' chip + video badges. Backend filter works perfectly on /api/providers. Frontend LIST view works perfectly (chip toggle, URL sync, badge on María's card). BUG: SPLIT view does not honor the has_video filter and the split-video-badge never renders because /api/providers/map ignores has_video and does not return video_url in its response payload.

critical.issue: Endpoint does NOT accept has_video query parameter. FastAPI silently drops it because the parameter is not declared in the signature (server.py lines 1230-1244). Frontend Search.jsx fetchMap() correctly sends has_video=true (line 96) but backend ignores it -> split view shows ALL 23 providers even when filter is active.

Response items (server.py lines 1317-1332) do NOT include the video_url field. As a result, the mini-cards in split view never render the split-video-badge even for María. The frontend condition `{p.video_url && ...}` is always false for mapProviders.

integration_issues.flow: Search > Split view + Con video filter
integration_issues.issue: Split view list iterates over mapProviders (Search.jsx line 295) which comes from /api/providers/map. Since the map endpoint ignores has_video and never returns video_url, (a) the filter has no effect in split view (shows 23 instead of 1) and (b) split-video-badge-maria-cleaning-services-sallisaw-ok never appears.

action_items: Backend: add `has_video: Optional[bool] = None` parameter to /api/providers/map (server.py ~line 1244) and apply `if has_video: query['video_url'] = {'$exists': True, '$ne': ''}` before the find().
Backend: include `video_url` in the items dict appended at server.py lines 1317-1332 (e.g. `'video_url': p.get('video_url')`) so the split-view mini-card can render the badge.
Optional: keep the list-view behavior as-is — it already works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Search.jsx duplicates filter serialization logic between doSearch() and fetchMap() (lines 60-67 vs 89-96) — would be safer to extract a buildFilterQs(state, overrides) helper. Otherwise every new filter has to be added in two places (which is exactly how the has_video on /providers/map was missed).

The split view counter `({mapProviders.length})` (Search.jsx line 284) shows total_with_coords from /providers/map, which is inconsistent with list-view's `providers.length`. When filters diverge between the two endpoints, the count visibly contradicts the list.
/api/providers/map (server.py line 1229) duplicates a large chunk of filter logic from /api/providers — consider extracting `_build_provider_query(...)` so future filters apply automatically to both.

success_rate.backend: 100% on /api/providers (4/4 tests), but /api/providers/map fails the integration requirement
success_rate.frontend: List view 100% — chip toggle, URL sync, active styling (#025F67 bg, white text), Maria's card-video-badge all verified. Split view: chip + URL OK but filter not applied and split-video-badge missing.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/iteration14_video_filter_test.py covers /api/providers?has_video flag (4 tests, all pass). After main agent patches /api/providers/map to accept has_video and to include video_url in response items, re-run the frontend split-view test: navigate to /buscar?view=split&has_video=true and assert (1) result count is 1, (2) [data-testid=split-video-badge-maria-cleaning-services-sallisaw-ok] is visible. List view already works — no need to re-test it.
rca of the issue: Root cause: the 'Con video' feature was implemented on /api/providers (list endpoint) but the equivalent code path on /api/providers/map (used by the split view list AND map) was not updated. fetchMap() in Search.jsx correctly forwards has_video=true, but FastAPI silently drops unknown query params, so the filter is a no-op. Additionally, the map endpoint projects only a curated subset of fields and video_url was not added — so even after fixing the filter, the badge would still not render. Reproduction: open /buscar?view=split&has_video=true. Expected: 1 result (María) with Video badge inline. Actual: 23 results, María visible but no Video badge. Mitigation: see action_items 1 and 2.
